merchant/30561.htm.text: Trader Papuma: For the eternal glory of the Flame! Child of the Flame, how are you? Have you been to the world beyond our homelands? It is not what I imagined. Still, glory can be won here in abundance! Look around and see if there's something you need.

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30561-pk.htm.text: Trader Papuma: Hoo hoo ... You are a lawbreaker. What a peaceful world! You are walking around as if nothing ever happened ... you, Great Lawbreaker! You better leave before I fetch my weapon! I don't know what I will end up doing to you! Hoo hoo!

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
